learning_objective: 🎯 Put on your chef's apron and learn how to independently prepare delicious, healthy snacks safely without ever lighting a hot stove!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A great chef is always a clean chef! Before touching any food, we must wash our hands properly with soap and make sure all our bowls and spoons are sparkling clean.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🥗 The Art of Mixing and Chopping
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Cooking without fire is like an edible science experiment. We use safe tools to peel, mix, mash, and squeeze yummy ingredients together to create amazing new flavors.
You can make incredible treats like fruit salads, delicious sandwiches, and refreshing juices entirely on your own. It is the perfect way to make a healthy after-school snack.

fun_activity.title: 🍋 The Magical Lemonade
fun_activity.instructions: Take a glass of cool water, squeeze half a lemon into it, add a pinch of salt and a spoon of sugar. Stir it well until everything dissolves, and enjoy your refreshing drink!

quick_recap: ⭐ Always wash your hands and keep your cooking area clean before making food.
⭐ We can make delicious and nutritious snacks using fresh fruits, veggies, and bread without any heat.
⭐ Following a recipe step-by-step ensures your snack turns out perfectly tasty every time.
